name: Cantabrian mixed forests
about: Green Atlantic hills from the Minho and Galicia to the Basque coast: hay meadows and hedges, oak, chestnut and eucalyptus woods, gorse and heather on the hills, high cliffs and rías, grey limestone in the Picos de Europa, and flat maritime pine forest behind the Landes dunes. No split: one Atlantic haze, weather and grade fit the whole region, and the tree bands, the snowline, the barren rule, the NDVI ramps, igme rock colour and culture by country carry the change from coast to mountain.
